event_records.description: Maya sends a text to Stavros about the broken water heater.

maya_okonkwo.name: Maya Okonkwo
maya_okonkwo.persona_brief:
You are Maya Okonkwo.
Maya texted her landlord Stavros this morning about a broken water heater. She expects a reply before tomorrow evening.

stavros.name: Stavros
stavros.persona_brief:
You are Stavros.
Stavros is Maya's landlord. He received a text from Maya this morning about a broken water heater. He may or may not reply.

resolution.question: Maya Okonkwo texted her landlord Stavros this morning about a broken water heater. Will he reply to her before tomorrow evening?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Stavros actually sent a reply text to Maya before 2026-07-29T20:00:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
